methodology.direction_predictions: Nested chronological V2 OOS probabilities generated before strategy selection
methodology.entry: Market entry 1-5 minutes before the inferred Friday close
methodology.execution: Historical spread, stop-first ambiguous M1 bars, adverse Monday stop-gap slippage, favorable TP gaps capped at target
methodology.selection: First 70 prediction weeks with three development blocks; final 41 weeks strategy holdout
